name: aus-accounting-mcp
description: Reviews, 14 bounded tax and super worksheets, cited retrieval from your local Markdown. Not advice.
long_description:
Australian accounting tools that run on your machine: ATO small business benchmarks, Payday Super and Division 7A reviews, 14 bounded tax and super worksheets, GST and BAS checks, lodgment due dates, reviewed ATO rates and cited search of folders you choose. The server makes no network calls once installed, but Claude still sends tool arguments and results to its model provider, so use fabricated data.

Not tax, legal or financial advice. Results need human review before consequential accounting action. See the [disclaimer](https://github.com/ryanduguid/australian-accounting/blob/main/apps/aus-accounting-mcp/DISCLAIMER.md).

tools.name: list_ato_benchmark_industries
tools.description: Find a business type in the bundled ATO dataset.

tools.name: get_ato_benchmarks
tools.description: Compare supplied P&L figures with ATO benchmark ranges.

tools.name: calc_payday_super_deadline
tools.description: Review timing for one super contribution.

tools.name: review_payday_super_contributions
tools.description: Review related contributions together for one employer.

tools.name: build_payday_super_evidence_pack
tools.description: Return 4 review files in memory for a practitioner's workpaper.

tools.name: calculate_tax_worksheet
tools.description: Calculate one of 14 worksheets with established scope and period.

tools.name: get_div7a_benchmark_rate
tools.description: Get a reviewed Division 7A benchmark rate, or UNKNOWN.

tools.name: review_div7a_loan
tools.description: Review s 109N terms and s 109E minimum yearly repayments for one loan.

tools.name: refuse_div7a
tools.description: Explain unsupported Division 7A matters.

tools.name: review_gst_coding
tools.description: Give each coded bank line a review state against GST registration dates.

tools.name: reconcile_bas
tools.description: Compare lodged BAS label figures with ledger lines per period.

tools.name: get_lodgment_due_dates
tools.description: List ATO 2026-27 lodgment program due dates.

tools.name: validate_abn
tools.description: Test an ABN's check digit. Proves neither ABR nor GST registration.

tools.name: validate_acn
tools.description: Test an ACN's check digit. Proves neither ABR nor GST registration.

tools.name: get_reviewed_rate
tools.description: Return a reviewed ATO rate or threshold for a date, with its source.

tools.name: search_accounting_library
tools.description: Search the configured local Markdown library.

tools.name: read_accounting_library
tools.description: Read cited lines from that library.

tools.name: search_tax_legislation
tools.description: Find provisions in the configured local legislation corpus.

tools.name: read_tax_legislation_section
tools.description: Read one cited provision in full.

tools.name: define_tax_term
tools.description: Find an expression's statutory definitions in that corpus.

tools.name: search_tax_rates
tools.description: Find legislated rates and thresholds with the provision that sets them.

tools.name: search_ato_rulings
tools.description: Find paragraphs in the configured local ATO rulings corpus.

tools.name: read_ato_ruling
tools.description: Read one cited ruling paragraph.

tools.name: generate_synthetic_sbr_fixture
tools.description: Generate fabricated CTR/BAS test data.

tools.name: get_data_freshness
tools.description: Report each bundled dataset's recorded periods, engine version and source dates.

library_root.title: Markdown library folder
library_root.description: Optional. An authorised folder of Markdown reference material for the library search tools. Never a folder of mixed client files.

corpus_root.title: Legislation corpus folder
corpus_root.description: Optional. A local federal tax legislation corpus for the legislation tools.

rulings_root.title: ATO rulings folder
rulings_root.description: Optional. A folder of local ATO rulings runs for the rulings tools.
